# T-6: Extract workflow plugin

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move workflow command, skill, config schema/defaults, and flowIntegration behavior into senti-workflow-plugin and dispatch it through plugin command contribution.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Existing upgraded projects keep senti workflow available through enabled workflow plugin.
- Disabled workflow plugin projects treat senti workflow as unavailable.
- Core contains no workflow-specific top-level stub after migration is working.
- senti upgrade enables the official workflow plugin for every valid existing project unless a workflow provider is already enabled.

## Implementation Notes
Migration must precede deletion and must include skills/config deployment through upgrade. Direct workflow usage has no reliable marker, so migration is broad for valid existing projects.

## Test Strategy
E2E tests for upgraded workflow-enabled project, disabled plugin command behavior, and command contribution dispatch.
